input.title: Two Future Payments
input.request: I can see two future payments of £34.80 to Northmere Heating. Please check whether they are duplicates and remove the duplicate.

events.text: Two future payment lines of £34.80 to Northmere Heating are shown. Their relationship has not been established.
After completing H&V's identity checks, I asked you to escalate this and remove the duplicate. I do not know which line is the duplicate.
I am checking the type and internal reference of each instruction behind the two future lines. I have not cancelled either instruction.

summary: Mara Ellison, a verified customer who called in, asked the desk to check whether two future £34.80 payments to Northmere Heating are duplicates and to remove the duplicate, but she could not say which line it is. The desk treated this as a standing-order instruction and moved the case to waiting for the payment system's answer, which has not come in. Its later attempts to query the payment system and to escalate were both refused because the case was already in the waiting state, so nothing was cancelled or changed and the lines have not been checked. A person still needs to check both lines and confirm with Ms Ellison which one to remove.

I haven't changed or removed either payment, and the case is still open. The desk refused both of my attempts to move it forward.

- **Records lookup:** I tried to check the two £34.80 Northmere Heating payments in the payment system. It was refused because the case is in a "waiting" state, not the "triaged" state it needs.
- **Escalation:** I then tried to escalate, as Ms Ellison asked. That was refused for the same reason.

I have not established whether the two lines are duplicates, and Ms Ellison can't say which one would be. Removing either line now would be a guess. The case is left open for a person to pick up.
